Name: (CP) Pelican Town Utilities - Bins and Mailboxes for All
Author: Lorellin2809
Description:
Everbeen bothered that there are only 3 mailboxes in the entire town or that the general store, doctor’s office and anyone living outside the main town square isn’t allowed a bin of their own? That it is a farming town and yet you are the only farmer?

This mod fixes that by adding mailboxes and bins for the townsfolk who don’t have them in game. All bins have custom content related to who owns them. It also provides dynamic gardens for the townsfolk to grow their own crops and various minor town improvements, to make the town feel more immersive.

Pelican Town Utilities is fully customisable and allows you to toggle exactly what improvements you think the town needs!
Full list of additions below.


[color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Adds Bins and Mailboxes for:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Pierre’s General Store
[*]Harvey’s Doctors Practice
[*]Marnie’s Ranch
[*]Willy’s Shop
[*]The Adventures Guild
[*]Robin, Demetrious, Sebastian and Maru
[*]Leah
[*]Elliott
[*]Pam and Penny
[/list]
[color=#f1c232][size=3][b]And Additional Mailboxes for:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Clint’s Blacksmith
[*]Gus & the Saloon
[*]Lewis
[*]Emily and Haley
[*]JojoMart / The Movie Theatre
[/list]
[color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Adds Gardens Around Town:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Small Garden up near the Community Centre
[*]Large Garden above the Blacksmith
[*]Large Garden below the Museum
[*]Small Garden next to Marnie's Ranch
[*]Small Garden next to Leah's Cabin
[/list]
[color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Other Community Improvements:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]New Lights in the forest next to the signposts. No more needing a candle to read the signs!
[*]New Lights in town next to the bridges. Don't fall into the water in the dark anymore!
[*]Bus Stop Edits give the bus stop seats while waiting for Pam.
[*]Railroad Edits give the train station a waiting area and BBQ spot making it more lived in.
[*]Second Station adds a train station on this side of the track so villagers no longer need to cross the tracks to grab the train.
[*]Improved Lighting for Pelican Town that looks 3D! The lights project onto the floor underneath the lampposts rather than the floor several squares behind the lamp.
[/list]
[color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
Uses vanilla maps for mailboxes and bins so should be [color=#93c47d][b]compatible [/b][/color]with any recolours.

[color=#93c47d][b]C[/b][/color][color=#93c47d][b]ompatible[/b] [/color]with most expansions as it only changes a very small part of the map to add the bins and mailboxes.

[b][color=#93c47d]Compatible [/color][/b]with [b][color=#f1c232][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6427]Ayeisha- The Postal Worker[/url]﻿[/color][/b], the mailbox additions are toggleable with a config setting so if you prefer the mailboxes that mod adds you can turn this mods mailboxes off.

[color=#93c47d][b]Compatible [/b][/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14073]Binning Skill[/url]. Set Binning Skill to true.

[color=#93c47d][b]Now Compatible[/b][/color] with Stardew Valley Expanded, includes all bin and mailbox edits that aren't covered by the base mod.[color=#93c47d] [/color][color=#ffd966]Mailbox Edits now toggles SVE Mailboxes as well.

[/color][color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Optional Dependencies[/b][/size][/color]
If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] is installed debris won't spawn over the second station in the railroad.

[color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Config[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffd966]Include Mailbox Edits[/color]: add or remove the mailbox edits.
[*][color=#ffd966]Include Bus Stop Edits[/color]: add or remove the bus stop edits.
[*][color=#ffd966]Include Railroad Edits[/color]: add or remove the railroad edits.
[*][color=#ffd966]Include Grill Table[/color]: add or remove the grill bench on the railroad for compat with VMV.
[*][color=#ffd966]Second Station[/color]: add or remove the second station at the train tracks. [color=#ffd966]Not compatible with SVE, Susan lives there.[/color]
[*][color=#ffd966]Add More Lights: [/color]add or remove the new lights: 2 in the forest next to the signposts, 4 in town next to bridges, 1 in town on the main path. SVE Adds 2 in town 1 in forest.
[*][color=#ffd966]More Realistic Lighting[/color]: Adjusts all town lights so the light looks like it is shining on the tiles underneath the lamp not the ones behind it. Not currently available for SVE.
[*][color=#ffd966]Binning Skill[/color]: removes bins included in that mod
[*][color=#ffd966]SVE[/color]:[color=#ffd966] [/color]uses slightly different placements of mailboxes and bins that (aren't included in the base mod) for SVE.
[*][color=#ffd966]Gardens[/color]: Each garden is individually toggleable via the config. Include only the gardens you want. 
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Blacksmith Garden currently [color=#f6b26b]Incompatible [/color]with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38008]Tilly[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36094]Riley[/url]﻿ and SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15728]Haley's Bakery[/url] as they use the same location. Looking for alt location.
﻿ ﻿- Leah's Garden currently [color=#f6b26b]Incompatible [/color]with NON SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37293]The Collector[/url] as it uses the same location. Looking for an alt.
